newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T says board united on no demerger.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T says board united on no demerger.

text.p: B.A.T chief executive Martin Broughton said on Wednesday demerger of its U.S. tobacco business would be "highly destructive" of shareholder value and said its board of directors was united on the issue.

He told Reuters Financial Television the demerger of Brown & Williamson would be "highly destructive of shareholder value". He said the company did not feel under any serious pressure to demerge, although he agreed the current B.A.T share price "unreasonably" did not reflect the value of the business.
Asked if the board was united on this issue, Broughton said, "No question."
